CREATE TABLE pc_memory_processing_records (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, attempt_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_memory_processing_started ON pc_memory_processing_records (scope_id, started_at, attempt_id)

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_processing_sources (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, source_type, source_id, attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_processing_artifacts (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, artifact_id, revision, attempt_id)
)
